blocks.md:
**Although / even though** + cümle: iki yarı **zıt kutupta**.
- yeni ↔ eski gibi zaman zıtlığı da sayılır
- **despite / in spite of** + isim veya Ving

| Bağlaç | Sonrası | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| although | cümle | Although it is cheap, it lasts long. |
| despite | isim / Ving | Despite its low cost, … |
| however | yeni cümle | It is cheap. However, … |

checks.q: ---- its small size, the sensor is very accurate.
The method is old; ----, it is still widely used.

title: Edatlar ve eşdizim
summary: at a rate, in terms of, due to, lead to

blocks.md:
- **at** a temperature / rate / level / speed
- **in terms of** = açısından
- **due to** + isim = -den dolayı
- **lead to** + isim = yol açmak

checks.q: The gas expands ---- a rate of 2% per degree.
